name: Roadster Race
summary: Roadster Race is a flying-car arcade racer that you play in your browser. Hold to take off, tap again in mid-air for a barrel roll, and boost when you dare: flying and boosting burn the same compressed air. Three modes: Race against AI drivers over 1,600 m on three difficulty levels, Survival, which gets faster and faster with 1 to 3 lives, and Turbo, where every coin makes you faster. Play solo or online with up to four players through an invite link, with AI drivers filling the empty seats, and put your best runs in the worldwide Hall of Fame. Four vibes (Neon, Demo, Grid and Tokyo), each with its own soundtrack, and more than 30 skins, including legendary cars that can only be earned. A parody of the flying-car promises, made by Ari Studios, an independent studio in Lyon, France.
